title: Cost Constellation: radial token-attribution view + export workflow
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Design and prototype a compact, role-aware token-level analytics surface (branded internally as "Cost Constellation") that combines a radial breakdown, attribution prism, and export mappings. The view should be embeddable in the Console dashboard, support selective rollup levels (message/session/model-route), and allow CSV/JSON export with mapping presets tied to pricing line-items. Objectives: make per-invocation cost attribution visible, provide quick filtering for high-cost prompts, and expose an export schema for downstream billing/chargeback systems.
acceptance_criteria: Interactive radial view that shows token distribution and cost share by segment (prompt/system/messages/model) with hover and drill-to-list
Attribution prism panel with top N contributors, ability to group by route/model/customer-tag, and time-window controls
Export flow that lets users map attribution dimensions to billing fields and download CSV/JSON; includes two default presets: "developer-friendly" and "finance-ready"
Role-aware presets: PMs see summary + change over time; Finance sees SKU mapping and export-ready CSV; Engineers can open raw traces and link to request traces
Prototype UI in Figma with annotated interaction spec and a short usability test report (at least 4 sessions)
Design handoff artifacts (tokens, components, behavior matrix) uploaded and linked to PRD and GitHub issue
decisions: Adopt radial visualization for quick at-a-glance percent-share, supplemented by an attribution prism list for exact numbers
Default time window set to 7 days with quick toggles for 24h/7d/30d to balance noise vs. signal
Two export presets will ship in MVP; advanced mapping editor deferred to a later cycle
Export file will include both token counts and normalized cost estimates plus model-version metadata to support reconciliations
comments: 2025-03-11 - Rohan: Initial sketches look promising, need to validate edge-case where a single request dominates token share (suggest including a 'dominance' flag).
2025-03-12 - Priya (PM): Finance asked that the export includes account-level tags and `route_id` — added to export schema draft.

2025-03-14 - Eng review (Elliot): Batch-aggregation constraints noted: the radial percentages should be computed post-batching to avoid double-counting KV cache hits. Follow-up ENG ticket recommended.
2025-03-15 - Design critique: reduce color palette to 6 discrete hues and use pattern fills for color-blind accessibility; also add microcopy explaining token vs cost assumption
2025-03-17 - Usability test summary: 4 participants, found export presets helpful; two participants wanted a scheduled export feature (epic candidate).
2025-03-18 - Rohan: Updated prototype and added behavior matrix; ready for PM sign-off pending minor copy changes.

PM sign-off on export fields and default presets
